question: What are the major learning outcomes of the CS program?
expected: MLO1 fundamentals in theory and systems; MLO2 explain emerging aspects (AI, ML, data science...); MLO3 develop real-world applications.

The Major Learning Outcomes (Major LOs) of the CS program include:

1. Students will be able to locate and critically analyze information and present evidence-based arguments in written and oral forms (GA1, GA4, GA5, GA6, GA7, GA9).
2. Students will be able to formulate quantitative inquiries and apply appropriate mathematical, statistical, or scientific methods to answer them (GA1, GA4, GA5, GA7, GA9).
3. Students will be able to develop real-world applications (e.g., software systems and frameworks, mobile apps, data pipeline, etc.) by using knowledge of computer science and other disciplines.
